request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Customers in Tunis and Sfax complained yesterday around lunchtime that web pages and apps would not load, even though their phones showed full signal. What was going on? Now: 2026-

parsed.title: Software upgrade regression on core DNS causing loading failures
parsed.root_cause_summary: A software upgrade on CORE-DNS-01 introduced a regression causing DNS timeout rates to spike and query success percentages to drop, leading to nationwide app and web loading failures.
parsed.confidence_reason: Direct evidence links software upgrade and DNS alarms to the incident, but maintenance calendar and external events were not checked.
parsed.impact_summary: Customers experienced app and web loading failures across Tunis and Sfax due to core DNS degradation.

timeline.event: Software upgrade patch applied to CORE-DNS-01.
Core DNS alert on query success percentage drop and resolution latency spike.
Major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE alarm raised on CORE-DNS-01.

findings.claim: A software upgrade was applied to CORE-DNS-01 at 11:00.
Core DNS query success percentage dropped and resolution latency spiked starting at 12:00.
A major DNS timeout rate alarm was raised on CORE-DNS-01 at 12:30.
The software upgrade caused DNS degradation, explaining widespread app and web loading failures.

hypotheses.reason: A software upgrade preceded the DNS timeout rates and query success degradation.
Core degradation was observed via DNS timeout rates, but it stems from the software upgrade change.

dismissed_signals.reason: Occurred later in the evening on 2026-09-02 and does not match the lunchtime customer complaint window.
Occurred on 2026-09-03, outside the incident impact window.

recommended_actions: Roll back the software upgrade on CORE-DNS-01 to restore normal DNS resolution.
Verify DNS query success rates and latency metrics post-rollback.
Check maintenance calendar for any overlapping planned activities.
